SECTION 1: SPEC BULLET ANALYSIS

✅ * Select electrons with pT > 25 GeV and |eta| < 2.5; computed as: l['pt'] > 25 and abs(l['eta']) < 2.5 and l['type'] == 1; upstream chain: electrons + muons; 〔L292-L293〕
✅ * Select muons with pT > 20 GeV and |eta| < 2.4; computed as: l['pt'] > 20 and abs(l['eta']) < 2.4 and l['type'] == 2; upstream chain: electrons + muons; 〔L294-L295〕
✅ * Use selected electrons and selected muons to define selected leptons.; computed as: leptons = [l for l in electrons + muons if ...]; upstream chain: electrons + muons; 〔L290-L296〕
✅ * Require exactly 1 selected lepton; computed as: len(leptons) == 1; upstream chain: leptons; 〔L299-L301〕
✅ * Require at least 2 jets with pT > 30 GeV and |eta| < 2.5; computed as: len([j for j in jets if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]) >= 2; upstream chain: jets; 〔L305-L307〕
✅ * Select MET > 30 GeV; computed as: met['pt'] > 30; upstream chain: helper_get_met(event); 〔L316-L318〕
✅ * Veto events with b-tagged jets; computed as: n_bjets(event, 30, 2.5) > 0; upstream chain: n_bjets(event, 30, 2.5); 〔L311-L312〕
✅ * Select transverse mass of lepton + MET between 40 and 120 GeV (W leptonic candidate); computed as: 40 < mt < 120; upstream chain: helper_transverse_mass(lepton, met); 〔L324-L325〕
✅ * Select invariant mass of the two leading jets between 60 and 100 GeV (W hadronic candidate); computed as: 60 < mjj < 100; upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(jet1, jet2); 〔L334-L335〕
✅ * Select delta R between the two leading jets < 3.0; computed as: dr < 3.0; upstream chain: helper_delta_r(jet1, jet2); 〔L339-L340〕

✅ * Plot the transverse mass of lepton + MET (W leptonic) in the range 30 to 150 GeV; computed as: mt; upstream chain: helper_transverse_mass(lepton, met); 〔L385-L389〕
✅ * Plot the invariant mass of the two leading jets (W hadronic) in the range 40 to 120 GeV; computed as: mjj; upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(jet1, jet2); 〔L392-L396〕
✅ * Plot the MET distribution; computed as: met['pt']; upstream chain: helper_get_met(event); 〔L399-L403〕
✅ * Plot the pT of the lepton; computed as: lepton['pt']; upstream chain: leptons[0]; 〔L406-L410〕
✅ * Plot the pT of the leading jet; computed as: jet1['pt']; upstream chain: helper_get_leading(jets); 〔L413-L417〕
✅ * Plot the pT of the subleading jet; computed as: jet2['pt']; upstream chain: helper_get_subleading(jets); 〔L420-L424〕
✅ * Plot delta R between the two leading jets; computed as: dr; upstream chain: helper_delta_r(jet1, jet2); 〔L427-L431〕
✅ * Plot delta phi between the lepton and MET; computed as: dphi; upstream chain: helper_delta_phi(lepton['phi'], met['phi']); 〔L434-L438〕
✅ * Plot the eta of the lepton; computed as: lepton['eta']; upstream chain: leptons[0]; 〔L441-L445〕
✅ * Plot delta phi between the lepton and the two-jet system; computed as: dphi_lepton_jets; upstream chain: helper_delta_phi(lepton['phi'], jet_system['phi']); 〔L448-L452〕
